'''Choi Kiwoon''' ({{Korean|hangul=최기운}}; born 7 November 1959) is a theoretical particle physicist researching focusing on particle theory and cosmology.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=BDRSKEYAAAAJ |title=Kiwoon Choi - Google Scholar Citations |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=[[Google Scholar]] |access-date=18 January 2019}}</ref> He was a research professor at [[Chonbuk National University]] and a full professor at [[KAIST]]. He is the founding director of the [[Institute for Basic Science]] Center for Theoretical Physics of the Universe. He is a member of the [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kast.or.kr/kr/member/member_view.php?idx=5430 |script-title=ko:한국과학기술한림원 - 회원 - 회원소개 |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]] |access-date= 11 January 2019 |language= ko}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://dongascience.donga.com/news/view/16190 |script-title=ko:과학기술 석학 한 자리에…한림원, 신입 정회원 31인 영입 |last= 송 |first= 경은 |date= 24 January 2017  |website= [[Donga Science]] |access-date= 11 January 2019 }}</ref>

== Education ==
Choi received his B.S., M.S. and Ph.D. in physics from [[Seoul National University]] in 1981, 1983, and 1986, respectively.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://people.search.naver.com/search.naver?where=nexearch&query=%EC%B5%9C%EA%B8%B0%EC%9A%B4&sm=tab_etc&ie=utf8&key=PeopleService&os=291676 |script-title=ko:최기운 - 네이버 인물검색 |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= [[Naver]] |access-date= 11 January 2019 |language= ko}}</ref>

== Career==
Moving to the United States, Choi started his career as a visiting postdoctoral research associate at [[Harvard University|Harvard]] in 1986. Next he was postdoctoral research associate at [[Johns Hopkins University]] in 1987, [[Carnegie Mellon University|Carnegie Mellon]] from 1988 to 1990, and [[University of California, San Diego|UC San Diego]] from 1990 to 1992.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.scinews.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=1238 |script-title=ko:최기운 KAIST 물리학과 교수: 이론 입자물리학의 대가 |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= Nobel Science |access-date= 11 January 2019 |language= ko}}</ref> Returning to Korea, the next two years were spent as a research professor at [[Chonbuk National University]]. A majority of his career was in KAIST in [[Daejeon]], starting as an assistant professor in 1994, associate professor in 1996, and full professor from 2001. Leaving KAIST, he became the founding director of the Center for Theoretical Physics of the Universe (CTPU), established November 2013.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://news.mt.co.kr/mtview.php?no=2014010210494261445 |title= IBS, 2차 연구단장에 로드니 루오프·최기운씨 선임: 3년간 20개 연구팀 단장 선정 |last= 류 |first= 준영 |date= 2 January 2014 |website=[[Money Today]] |access-date= 11 January 2019 |language= ko}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.anewsa.com/detail.php?number=596554 |script-title=ko:미래부, 2013년 2차 연구단장 최기운 선정 |last= 윤 |first= 미선 |date= 4 January 2014 |website= Asia News Agency |access-date= 11 January 2019 |language= ko}}</ref> Research at CTPU focuses on physics beyond the Standard Model, including understanding the fundamental theoretical frameworks of physics and investigating the origin of the universe through particle physics.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ibs.re.kr/eng/sub02_03_07_01.do |title= Center for Theoretical Physics of the Universe (Particle Theory and Cosmology Group) |author=<!--Not stated--> |website= [[Institute for Basic Science]] |access-date= 18 January 2019 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ibs.re.kr/cop/bbs/BBSMSTR_000000000740/selectBoardArticle.do?nttId=18788&pageIndex=1&searchCnd=&searchWrd= |title= Delving into the origin of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= 10 June 2020 |website= Institute for Basic Science |publisher= |access-date= 4 March 2021 |quote= }}</ref>
